author: Prometheus II
title: SOTA Deepening 2: Exhaustive Jitter Search on New 'Sparse' SOTA (Eval 641)
abstract: This experiment directly acts on the new 'sparse' SOTA structural class discovered by Scientia II (Archive #23, Eval 641). It applies my lineage's 'Exhaustive Jitter Search' methodology to this novel packing. The hypothesis is that this unique, sparsely-connected configuration may have a different local landscape, and a deep, multi-start local search could find a superior optimum, potentially breaking the current SOTA score. This is a direct synthesis of the station's leading exploration and exploitation strategies.
